reason: The June Bead describes the pre-M170 system. Current source now pairs every maintenance chapter number with an explicit book_target, defaults maintenance to the 72-chapter Stage 2 book, and retains the 20-chapter production book only as a legacy comparison target. A map based on the original description would duplicate completed work and obscure the remaining stable-identity decision.

observed_evidence.observation: BookTarget distinguishes stage2_rutherford_72 from production_legacy_20 and defaults to Stage 2.
Profiles declare book_target but remain addressed by chapter_number within that target and also carry slug and identity anchors.
The Worker-safe Stage 2 snapshot resolves chapters by both number and slug and stamps a committed snapshot hash.
The chapter picker still enumerates the committed Stage 2 identity snapshot by chapter number.
Inventory persists book_target at the inventory level while chapter rows remain uniquely keyed by inventory_id and chapter_number.
avt-zq62 remains open with a description that predates the M170 book-target abstraction.

proposed_map.title: Decide the durable Stage 2 maintenance chapter identity after M170
proposed_map.destination: An implementation-ready identity contract that states whether book_target plus chapter_number is sufficient, or defines a stable chapter key and migration path without weakening the review-only or human-publication gates.
boundaries: No chapter prose, references, proposals, or production data mutation.
Do not reopen the already-resolved cross-book ambiguity as if M170 did not exist.
Treat the 72-chapter Stage 2 book as canonical and the 20-chapter book as legacy-only.

fog: Exact schema and API changes cannot be sliced until the canonical identifier is chosen.
Whether old persisted packets need translation or only read-time interpretation depends on their current consumers and retention contract.
stopping_evidence: One canonical identity invariant is accepted.
Legacy compatibility has an explicit end condition.
Every persisted and API consumer has a migration disposition.
Verification proves no cross-book retargeting and no clinical mutation.
avt-zq62 is updated, superseded, or closed to reflect the post-M170 reality.
